Event.Cycle is set on the warning.

fix: Put the pair key (cycle and phase), the start signal's timestamp and its run id into the reason and into typed fields of the warning event (cycle, phase, run_id, started_at), and set Event.Cycle so cycle-scoped readers see it. summary: Wave 171 (2026-11-13 21:48Z, 22:17Z, 23:07Z): the H4 listener (go/internal/signalcenter/expected.go, PR 1437) emitted SIGNAL_EXPECTED_ABSENT three times with the reason 'phase: phase.dispatched was not followed by phase.outcome,phase.aborted within 1h30m0s'. The reason does not name the cycle, the phase or the start time, so the operator cannot act on it. The pair already has a Key function (keyByCyclePhase) that holds this identity. Plan: docs/plans/pipeline-health-indexes-2026-11.md (H4, D3/D4); spec: docs/architecture/signal-center-design.md section 8.1.
